2609.05066.title: Adaptive Multi-Granularity Temporal Modeling for Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
2609.05066.paper_summary: As the scale of video surveillance data outpaces manual annotation capacities, weakly supervised video anomaly detection (WSVAD) has emerged as a critical research frontier. Most existing approaches formulate WSVAD within a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) framework that relies on rigid, hand-crafted temporal priors to supervise anomaly scoring. However, such formulations exhibit limited adaptability to the wide variation in anomaly durations and temporal dynamics observed in real-world videos, often leading to unstable or unreliable snippet-level predictions. To address this limitation, we propose an adaptive temporal modeling framework for WSVAD that explicitly accounts for variations in video dynamics across multiple temporal granularities. First, we introduce a Temporal Refinement Module (TRM) that leverages dynamic positional encoding and a learnable class token to model long-range temporal dependencies while distilling a stable global video-level representation. Second, to capture anomalous events with varying frequency and duration, we develop an adaptive Event Segmentation Module (ESM) that identifies event boundaries through temporal discontinuity analysis and aggregates snippet features into discriminative event-level representations. Finally, for snippet-level and event-level predictions, we propose an adaptive similarity-based fusion strategy that dynamically integrates anomaly scores into video-level predictions, replacing fixed top-k aggregation heuristics with global semantic relevance. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
2609.05066.paper_summary_zh: 隨著視頻監控數據的規模超過手動標註的能力，弱監督視頻異常檢測（WSVAD）已成為一個關鍵的研究前沿。大多數現有的方法將WSVAD構建在多實例學習（MIL）框架內，依賴於剛性、手工製作的時間先驗來監督異常評分。然而，這種公式在適應真實世界視頻中觀察到的異常持續時間和時間動態的廣泛變化方面表現有限，經常導致不穩定或不可靠的片段級預測。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了一個自適應時間建模框架，用於WSVAD，該框架明確考慮了多個時間粒度下視頻動態的變化。首先，我們引入了一個時間精煉模塊（TRM），該模塊利用動態位置編碼和可學習的類別標記來建模長距離的時間依賴性，同時提煉出穩定的全局視頻級表示。其次，為了捕捉具有不同頻率和持續時間的異常事件，我們開發了一個自適應事件分割模塊（ESM），通過時間不連續性分析來識別事件邊界，並將片段特徵聚合成區分性事件級表示。最後，針對片段級和事件級預測，我們提出了一種自適應基於相似性的融合策略，該策略動態地將異常分數整合到視頻級預測中，取代固定的top-k聚合啟發式方法，並使用全局語義相關性。對兩個基準的廣泛實驗表明，所提出的框架在性能上始終優於最先進的方法。
2609.05066.author: Changyi Li et.al.
